d:
Bhojpuri sinema ke suprastar khesari lal yadav abhinay ke bad ab rajniti ke maidan men utar chuke hain. unhonne rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ki sadasyata li hai aur chhapra sit se chunavi maidan men hain. aarjedi jvain karne, lalu yadav, tejasvi yadav aur apni rajnitik vichardhara par unhonne bibisi sanvaddata situ tivari se bat ki.
Vidiyo: shahanvaz ahmad
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
